project.name: Hello Butler
project.description: Android daily-event scheduling, due-time execution, and independent audio preparation, based on repository main.

workflows.name: Daily Event Scheduling
workflows.description: Reconciles event changes and registers an exact alarm or WorkManager fallback for eligible spoken events and reminders.

nodes.title: Event reconciled
nodes.description: An event is created, updated, synchronized, or restored.
nodes.notes: DailyEventRepository.kt → update(), queue(), synchronize(); DailyEventScheduler.kt → reconcile(), schedule().

nodes.title: Eligible to schedule?
nodes.description: Checks planned status, trigger time, speech eligibility, content, and playback state.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → schedule(). Events without speakAloud are excluded unless eventType is reminder. A missing trigger, empty content, terminal status, or prior playback attempt also excludes the event.

nodes.title: Trigger time passed?
nodes.description: Determines whether the event is due or still in the future.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → schedule(), triggerAtMillis(). Reminders subtract reminderMinutesBefore from their start time.

nodes.title: Still due today?
nodes.description: Checks whether an already-due occurrence remains valid for speech.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → isDueForSpeech(). The event must belong to the current local date and remain unclaimed.

nodes.title: Exact alarm allowed?
nodes.description: Checks whether Android permits exact alarm registration.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → schedule(). Uses AlarmManager.canScheduleExactAlarms() on Android S and newer.

nodes.title: Register exact alarm
nodes.description: Registers a wake-up alarm with event ID, version, and trigger time.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → alarmPendingIntent(), AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(). If registration throws, the implementation enqueues DailyEventExecutionWorker instead.

nodes.title: Enqueue fallback work
nodes.description: Registers a version-bound WorkManager execution request.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecution.kt → DailyEventExecutionWorker.enqueue(). Uses unique work with ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE.

nodes.title: Cancel registration
nodes.description: Cancels existing alarm, worker, and deferred notification.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → cancel().

nodes.title: Not scheduled
nodes.description: No active scheduled execution remains for this event.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → cancel().

nodes.title: Alarm registered
nodes.description: The event will enter the alarm receiver when Android delivers the alarm.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAlarmReceiver.onReceive() is the downstream entry point.

nodes.title: Worker registered
nodes.description: WorkManager will attempt notification-based execution.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecutionWorker.doWork() is the downstream entry point.

useCases.name: Future event with speech
useCases.description: A planned spoken event has a future trigger and exact alarm permission.

useCases.name: Ordinary silent event
useCases.description: A planned non-reminder event has speakAloud disabled.
useCases.notes: Expected: Not scheduled. The existing scheduler does not provide a generic silent-event notification path.

useCases.name: Exact alarm unavailable
useCases.description: An eligible future event must use WorkManager.

useCases.name: Past event expired
useCases.description: An old event is no longer due on the current date.

workflows.name: Due Event Execution
workflows.description: Handles a delivered alarm or fallback worker, validates the occurrence, offers a notification, and optionally starts automatic speech.

nodes.title: Scheduled trigger fires
nodes.description: Android delivers an alarm or WorkManager executes its fallback task.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecution.kt → DailyEventAlarmReceiver.onReceive(), DailyEventExecutionWorker.doWork().

nodes.title: Load event from Room
nodes.description: Reads the latest persisted event using its ID.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAlarmReceiver.onReceive() and DailyEventExecutionWorker.doWork() → dailyEventDao().get(eventId).

nodes.title: Occurrence valid?
nodes.description: Rejects deleted, obsolete, non-due, or already attempted events.
nodes.notes: DailyEventScheduler.kt → isDueForSpeech(), matchesAlarm(). Validates event version and trigger identity.

nodes.title: Offer event playback
nodes.description: Checks current session and event state before publishing a deferred Listen notification.
nodes.notes: DailyEventRepository.kt → offerEventPlayback(). The method uses audioStateMutex and checks local preparedSpeech() without downloading audio. DeferredSpeechNotification.show() presents Listen or Prepare & Listen.

nodes.title: Offer accepted?
nodes.description: Checks whether the notification offer completed or was unnecessary.
nodes.notes: offerEventPlayback() returns true for a successful publication or an obsolete or unauthorized occurrence. A false result triggers worker retry or fallback enqueue.

nodes.title: Exact alarm path?
nodes.description: Distinguishes an alarm receiver from delayed worker execution.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecution.kt. The worker deliberately avoids starting automatic foreground playback from the background.

nodes.title: Auto speech allowed?
nodes.description: Checks the sound and voice preference for this event workflow.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAlarmReceiver.onReceive() → soundVoice.state.value.allows(AudioWorkflows.forEvent(event.eventType)).

nodes.title: Request auto playback
nodes.description: Starts the shared playback service for the captured event occurrence.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAlarmReceiver.onReceive() → ButlerAudioPlaybackService.playEvent(automatic = true, expectedVersion, expectedTrigger). IllegalStateException and SecurityException cause fallback worker enqueue.

nodes.title: Queue retry worker
nodes.description: Schedules or retries the notification offer without starting background playback.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecutionWorker.enqueue() or Result.retry() in doWork(). Retry scheduling is collapsed into one node to avoid a graph cycle.

nodes.title: Occurrence ignored
nodes.description: The scheduled occurrence no longer qualifies for execution.
nodes.notes: The receiver returns or the worker reports success without presenting playback.

nodes.title: Manual action offered
nodes.description: Automatic speech is not requested; a valid notification offer remains available.
nodes.notes: For ready local audio the notification offers Listen; otherwise Prepare & Listen. Actual notification visibility depends on Android permissions.

nodes.title: Playback requested
nodes.description: The shared service has been asked to handle automatic playback.
nodes.notes: This does not guarantee audible completion; the service performs further validation and claims.

nodes.title: Retry queued
nodes.description: A later worker attempt will reevaluate the event.
nodes.notes: DailyEventExecutionWorker.

useCases.name: Automatic spoken reminder
useCases.description: A valid reminder fires through its exact alarm with automatic speech enabled.

useCases.name: Notification-only reminder
useCases.description: A valid reminder fires but automatic speech is disabled.

useCases.name: Stale edited event
useCases.description: The alarm contains an old version or trigger time.

useCases.name: Notification offer failed
useCases.description: The event is valid but notification publication cannot complete.

workflows.name: Event Audio Preparation
workflows.description: Prepares and stores server-generated audio independently of the event's scheduled trigger.

nodes.title: Audio worker starts
nodes.description: WorkManager starts a network-constrained audio preparation task.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.kt → enqueue(), doWork(). Work is unique by event ID and version, with CONNECTED network constraint and exponential backoff.

nodes.title: Session exists?
nodes.description: Checks whether the user has an active authenticated session.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.doWork() → authRepository.hasSession(). Without a session, the worker exits successfully without preparation.

nodes.title: Load current event
nodes.description: Reads the event from Room using the worker's event ID.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.doWork() → dailyEventDao().get(id).

nodes.title: Audio still eligible?
nodes.description: Validates event version and eligibility for prepared speech.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.kt → canPrepareSpeech(). Requires synced server event, positive version, planned status, speakAloud or reminder type, valid trigger, nonempty text, and event date not before today.

nodes.title: Prepare event speech
nodes.description: Reuses local prepared audio or requests server preparation and downloads ready audio.
nodes.notes: DailyEventRepository.kt → speechAudio(eventId, version). Checks pending edits, calls prepareEventSpeech(), then eventAudio() when ready. Validates version header and Ogg/Opus container before atomic publication.

nodes.title: Preparation outcome?
nodes.description: Classifies the result as ready, pending, retryable, or terminal failure.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.doWork() → speechAudio(), eventAudioRetryable(). Null audio triggers retry; retryable HTTP codes include 202, 408, 424, 429, and 5xx. IOException also retries. Terminal API errors fail the worker.

nodes.title: Preparation skipped
nodes.description: No audio preparation is performed for this worker invocation.
nodes.notes: Result.success() for missing session, missing event, stale version, or ineligible event.

nodes.title: Audio prepared
nodes.description: A valid prepared audio file is available locally.
nodes.notes: DailyEventRepository.speechAudio() and DailyEventSpeechStore.publish().

nodes.title: Preparation retry
nodes.description: WorkManager will retry preparation according to its backoff policy.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.doWork() → Result.retry().

nodes.title: Preparation failed
nodes.description: The worker reports a non-retryable preparation failure.
nodes.notes: DailyEventAudioWorker.doWork() → Result.failure(). Certain API errors also queue synchronization.

useCases.name: Audio prepared successfully
useCases.description: A valid synchronized event receives ready audio from the server.

useCases.name: Silent ordinary event
useCases.description: A non-reminder event has speakAloud disabled.

useCases.name: Server audio still pending
useCases.description: The server has not finished preparing the requested audio.

useCases.name: Non-retryable API failure
useCases.description: The server rejects preparation with a terminal API error.
